candidate.title: Docker cannot allocate a non-overlapping bridge network
candidate.problem: Container creation fails because Docker cannot allocate a bridge subnet that does not overlap an existing one.
signals: could not find an available non-overlapping ipv4 address pool
applicability: the configured default address pools are actually exhausted
candidate.root_cause: The daemon's default-address-pools are fully allocated.
candidate.approach: Expand default-address-pools in the daemon configuration and restart.
constraints: existing networks are not migrated to the new pool
verify the ranges are genuinely exhausted before changing daemon config
